create_serializer_for_search_data: create a Serializer instance with configurable file offset, result ID, and name size bytes for packing search data
serialize_search_data: build a serialized bytearray from a Trie, ResultMap, and type map using serialize_search_data with merge options
deserialize_search_data: create a Deserializer from serialized bytes using Deserializer.from_serialized to unpack search data structure
pretty_print_search_data: run pretty_print on serialized search data bytes to display trie, result map, and type map with optional colors
base85encode_search_data: encode a search data bytearray into a Base85 JavaScript load string using base85encode_search_data
